name: Huggie earring
definition: small thick-ish hoop that sits close to the lobe, closed with a hinge, snap or push-back (shops sell huggies apart from larger hoops).
notes: Huggie earrings sold as own category apart from hoops

name: Threader earring
definition: fine chain or bar threaded through the lobe piercing and left hanging at both ends.
notes: Threader earrings sold as own category

name: Chandelier earring
definition: tiered or branching ornate drop earring that fans out below the lobe.
notes: Chandelier is a separate earring silhouette filter

name: Hair comb
definition: decorative comb with teeth pushed into the hair as an ornament.
notes: Hair combs sold as own category beside barrettes, clips

name: Wedding band
definition: plain or set ring sold as a wedding or anniversary band, in a bridal range.
notes: Wedding bands sold as own category beside stackable rings
